def: A library that packages the agent loop together with a tool registry, state, tracing and retry rules, so that you write less plumbing and accept some behaviour you did not write.
A complete working agent, with built-in tools, permissions and context management, that you embed and configure rather than assemble.
A description of an agent's flow as nodes (steps) and edges (what follows), with a typed state object saved after each node so a run can pause, resume or replay.
A check on an agent's input or output, run by the framework, that can block or flag a request or reply.
A thin wrapper around the model interface that records each request exactly as it leaves your process, showing what a framework really sends.
Instructions a framework adds to the system prompt or tool descriptions on its own, which cost tokens and shape behaviour without appearing in your source.
A thin file that translates between your own tools, state and evaluation cases and one framework's objects, so the framework can be replaced by writing another adapter.
The part of a framework that executes a loop or graph of steps and keeps its state, as opposed to only calling a model API.
